verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PR creation is possible on GitHub Mobile, primarily via Copilot natural-language flows (docs-6) and assigning issues to Copilot for a ready PR (docs-5), plus general merge/review support (docs-1). However, there's no first-party detail on a standard manual 'create PR' button flow, and community reports focus on review/notification bugs rather than confirming smooth PR creation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots of manual PR creation UI, independent hands-on confirmation that PR creation works reliably on-device.
